results.rule: a draft or revoked entitlement grants nothing
failingTests: H: fail closed draft and revoked records grant nothing

results.rule: the variant must equal the catalogue variant (a price entitlement is not a TRI entitlement)
failingTests: H: fail closed variant mismatch (a PRICE entitlement is not a TRI entitlement) and currency mismatch grant nothing

results.rule: post-expiry retention never applies before the term starts
failingTests: H: term, post-expiry retention and data-date scope before valid_from nothing is granted

results.rule: a customer-visible comparison needs the DISPLAY right as well as calculation
failingTests: H: rights are separate storage + calculation without ingestion cannot publish; without display cannot show a comparison; without export cannot export
H: rights are separate the action table is the documented one

results.rule: a manual-ingest licence is not automation permission
failingTests: H: rights are separate a manual-ingest licence is NOT automation permission

results.rule: data-date scope is enforced (a range outside the entitled range is refused)
failingTests: H: term, post-expiry retention and data-date scope data-date scope: a requested range outside the entitled range is refused, inside is allowed
H: term, post-expiry retention and data-date scope any ONE sufficient record is enough, but a record with the right for the wrong scope is not combined with another

results.rule: consumer gate fails closed for an unknown benchmark
failingTests: consumer gate (benchmarkAccess): fail closed, scope clamp, honest reasons undefined access (unknown benchmark) is no access for every need

results.rule: an entitlement lookup failure blocks everything (never a partial grant)
failingTests: consumer gate (benchmarkAccess): fail closed, scope clamp, honest reasons loadBenchmarkAccess: an RPC error blocks EVERYTHING (empty map + error), a missing function likewise

results.rule: series outside the entitled data-date scope are dropped
failingTests: consumer gate (benchmarkAccess): fail closed, scope clamp, honest reasons series points outside the entitled data-date scope are dropped; with no access nothing is returned

results.rule: the global kill switch stops everything before any other read
failingTests: J gates: nothing is fetched or written unless EVERY gate holds global kill switch OFF: no entitlement read, no lease, no fetch, no write, no attempt recorded

results.rule: the central entitlement (automation + storage) gates every run
failingTests: J gates: nothing is fetched or written unless EVERY gate holds NO automation entitlement (a manual-ingest licence only): skipped_not_entitled, no lease, no fetch
J gates: nothing is fetched or written unless EVERY gate holds entitlement revoked / expired / wrong variant: skipped_not_entitled

results.rule: single-flight lease: an overlapping run is refused
failingTests: J gates: nothing is fetched or written unless EVERY gate holds overlapping jobs: when the lease is held by another runner nothing is fetched (single-flight)
J gates: nothing is fetched or written unless EVERY gate holds the lease is ALWAYS released, even when the adapter throws

results.rule: the write kill switch makes a run a dry run (nothing written)
failingTests: J gates: nothing is fetched or written unless EVERY gate holds WRITE kill switch OFF: the source is fetched and validated but NOTHING is written (dry_run, not success)

results.rule: HTTP 200 with no expected data is NOT success unless coverage is already complete
failingTests: J success is honest HTTP 200 with NO expected data is NOT success while coverage is behind (empty_response, failure counted, backoff set)

results.rule: a source refusal (403/captcha) stops the run (no probing of further benchmarks)
failingTests: J success is honest blocked (403/captcha): STOP - the run records blocked, makes one request and skips later benchmarks

results.rule: an implausible (>25%) value is never written
failingTests: J success is honest implausible rows (>25% spike) and invalid rows are never written; the run is partial, not success, and a critical alert is raised

results.rule: manual-import benchmarks are never fetched
failingTests: J gates: nothing is fetched or written unless EVERY gate holds manual_import / disabled benchmarks are skipped as source-disabled without any request (and a skip is not an attempt)
J gates: nothing is fetched or written unless EVERY gate holds the per-benchmark SOURCE switch (automation_enabled=false) stops the run even in automated mode

results.rule: the daily late-retry budget is bounded
failingTests: J success is honest late publication: the daily retry budget is bounded (late_retry is skipped once the budget is spent)

results.rule: a backoff window is honoured
failingTests: J gates: nothing is fetched or written unless EVERY gate holds backoff window active: skipped_backoff; expired backoff runs

results.rule: gap tolerance is bounded (a long gap stops the completeness watermark)
failingTests: watermarks and the calendar completeness: full coverage -> watermark = last date; a short gap (<= 3 weekdays) is tolerated and disclosed; a long gap stops the watermark before it
watermarks and the calendar a leading gap (history missing at the start) or no data at all gives a NULL watermark (never a claim of coverage)
manual-import mode: pending-import task (never described as automatic) history missing at the start makes an otherwise current benchmark DUE

results.rule: a manual import becomes OVERDUE past the threshold
failingTests: manual-import mode: pending-import task (never described as automatic) current / due / overdue by weekdays behind the expected session

results.rule: a benchmark never imported is reported as never_imported (not current)
failingTests: manual-import mode: pending-import task (never described as automatic) never imported => never_imported (critical when demand exists), with an upload instruction that says manual

results.rule: only HELD schemes create benchmark demand (no full-universe backfill)
failingTests: I selective-history demand: aggregated by exact benchmark, mapping-bounded, no full-universe backfill NOT held, or with no dated history, creates NO demand (no full-universe backfill)

results.rule: mapping-effective periods bound the demand
failingTests: I selective-history demand: aggregated by exact benchmark, mapping-bounded, no full-universe backfill mapping-effective periods bound the demand: a mapping that ended before the scheme history began creates none; a later start clamps the window

results.rule: a DEV job cannot ingest into another project (environment ref guard)
failingTests: environment guard: a DEV job can never write production and vice versa refuses when the project ref is not configured, absent, or different from the connected project

results.rule: a CORRECTION publish needs the correct capability (not the publish capability)
failingTests: s2/s4: capability MATRIX - every route x every capability (each capability gates only its own routes) POST jobs/[id]/publish (correction job): holder of ONLY publish -> 403
s2/s4: capability MATRIX - every route x every capability (each capability gates only its own routes) POST jobs/[id]/publish (correction job): holder of ONLY correct -> passes the guard
s5 separation of duties across capabilities a publisher cannot publish a CORRECTION job and a corrector cannot publish NEW history
